continuation_rules.preserve_program: Maintain all roadmap IDs, evidence, dependencies and future items; do not restart or collapse to the next three slices.
continuation_rules.source_rebinding: Verify actual merged SHA, current policy, merge delta, configuration and final checkpoint; create a compatible successor via existing coordinator only under actual authorization.
continuation_rules.execution_budget: At most four useful disjoint lanes; shared manifests/checkpoints remain coordinator-owned. Bounded retries only with new causal evidence.
continuation_rules.trust: No role-name independence, fixture-principal trust, score-based closure or inference of permission from a policy/receipt.
continuation_rules.metrics: Denominated descriptive observations only; preserve overlapping cohorts and unknown causal outcomes.
continuation_rules.retention: Repository-relative retrievable evidence and immutable artifacts; no runner-local environment as durable evidence.
